channel.title: Wartabiye TV
channel.description: Wararka Soomaaliya, Afrika, adduunka iyo ciyaaraha.

item.title: MSF oo ka digtay cudurro faafa kadib daadad xooggan oo Mudug ka go'doomiyay adeegyada caafimaadka
item.description: Hay'adda Dhakhaatiirta Aan Xuduudda Lahayn (MSF) ayaa sheegtay in daadadkii roobabka Deyrta ay qoysas badan oo gobolka Mudug ku nool ka xireen helitaanka adeegyada caafimaadka, iyadoo kiisaska shubanka biyaha iyo nafaqo-darrada carruurta ay sare u kaceen.

item.title: Uganda oo cutub cusub oo ciidanka cirka ah u dirtay howlgalka AUSSOM ee Soomaaliya
item.description: Uganda ayaa u diyaarisay Soomaaliya cutubkeeda lixaad ee ciidanka cirka, kaas oo qayb ka noqonaya howlgalka Midowga Afrika ee Taageerada iyo Xasillinta Soomaaliya (AUSSOM), sida ay sheegeen saraakiisha ciidamada Uganda.

item.title: Costa Rica oo u diiday Francesca Albanese inay dalka gasho, iyadoo ku eedaysay xiriir 'argagixiso'
item.description: Costa Rica ayaa u diiday ergayga gaarka ah ee Qaramada Midoobay ee dhulka Falastiiniyiinta la haysto, Francesca Albanese, inay dalka soo gasho, iyadoo ku doodday sababo la xiriira amniga qaranka. Albanese ayaa go'aanka ku tilmaantay 'ceeb'.

item.title: Baaritaanka Sandpapergate oo dib u eegi doona xilli ciyaareedkii 2017-18 oo dhan, Ashes-ka ku jiro
item.description: Madasha ay Cricket Australia u sameysay fadeexadda khalkhalinta kubbadda ee loo yaqaan Sandpapergate ayaa eegi doonta habka loo maareynayay kubbadda intii lagu jiray xilli ciyaareedkii 2017-18 oo dhan, oo ay ku jirto taxanihii Ashes ee England, sida lagu sheegay shuruudaha baaritaanka ee la daabacay Jimcaha.

item.title: Madaxweynaha Zimbabwe Mnangagwa oo booqasho rasmi ah ku jooga Kenya
item.description: Madaxweynaha Zimbabwe, Emmerson Mnangagwa, ayaa booqasho rasmi ah ku jooga Kenya, halkaas oo uu la yeelanayo Madaxweyne William Ruto wadahadallo lagu ballaarinayo ganacsiga iyo maalgashiga, iyadoo la furayo shirka ugu horreeya ee Guddiga Labada Qaran.

item.title: NFL: Bills oo 13-10 ku garaacday Chiefs, Tyler Bass oo kulanka ku go'aamiyay ilbiriqsiyadii u dambeeyay
item.description: Buffalo Bills ayaa ciyaartii Thanksgiving 13-10 kaga adkaatay Kansas City Chiefs, kadib markii Tyler Bass uu 4 ilbiriqsi ka hor dhammaadka ku dhaliyay field goal 57 yard ah.

item.title: Lazio oo ciyaarta Torino ku waayaysa Kenneth Taylor oo dhaawac murqo ah ku dhacay
item.description: Khadka dhexe ee reer Holland Kenneth Taylor ayaan ka qayb geli doonin kulanka Lazio ee Sabtida ay la ciyaarayso Torino, kadib markii uu tababarkii Arbacada ku joojiyay dhibaato murqeed, sida ay sheegeen warbixinnada Talyaaniga.

item.title: Macron oo si adag u cambaareeyay rabshadihii taageerayaasha Marseille iyo Levski Sofia
item.description: Madaxweynaha Faransiiska, Emmanuel Macron, ayaa cambaareeyay rabshadihii loo geystay taageerayaasha Bulgaria ka hor kulankii Europa League ee Marseille iyo Levski Sofia, wuxuuna ballan qaaday in falalkaas aan la dhaafi doonin ciqaab la'aan.

item.title: Kubadda koleyga: Talyaaniga oo 86-72 ku garaacay Turkiga isreebka Koobka Adduunka 2027
item.description: Xulka kubadda koleyga ee Talyaaniga ayaa Khamiistii 86-72 ku garaacay Turkiga, taas oo ahayd guuldarradii ugu horreysay ee Turkiga ee isreebka Yurub ee Koobka Adduunka FIBA 2027.

item.title: Jerry Jones oo difaacay Mike McCarthy kadib eedeymihii Aaron Rodgers
item.description: Milkiilaha Dallas Cowboys, Jerry Jones, ayaa beeniyay eedeymihii Aaron Rodgers uu u jeediyay tababaraha Pittsburgh Steelers Mike McCarthy, kadib markii Steelers ay Rodgers ka saartay kooxda kadibna sii deysay.

item.title: Trump oo sheegay in guusha Iran ay 'gacanta ugu jirto', kana yareeyay taageerada Ruushka iyo Shiinaha
item.description: Madaxweynaha Mareykanka, Donald Trump, ayaa xilli uu telefoon kula hadlayay ciidamada Mareykanka munaasabadda Thanksgiving sheegay in guusha dagaalka Iran ay gacanta ugu jirto, isagoo Tehran ugu baaqay inay heshiis gasho, kana yareeyay warbixinnada ku saabsan taageerada Ruushka iyo Shiinaha.

item.title: Eagles oo 39-38 ku garaacay Cowboys, kadib soo-kabasho taariikhi ah oo Thanksgiving ah
item.description: Philadelphia Eagles ayaa Khamiistii Dallas ku garaacay Dallas Cowboys 39-38, iyagoo ka soo kabtay farqi 21 dhibcood ah, taas oo lagu tilmaamay soo-kabashada ugu weyn taariikhda ciyaaraha Thanksgiving ee NFL.

item.title: New Zealand: isbahaysiga xukuma oo hal kursi uga dhiman aqlabiyadda baarlamaanka
item.description: Natiijooyinka rasmiga ah ee kama dambaysta ah ee doorashadii New Zealand ayaa muujiyay in isbahaysiga uu hoggaamiyo Ra'iisul Wasaare Christopher Luxon uu helay 65 kursi oo ka mid ah 130, oo hal kursi ka yar aqlabiyadda, taas oo ku khasbaysa inuu taageero ka raadsado xisbiga dhexdhexaadka ah ee Opportunity.

item.title: Levski Sofia oo dalbatay ciqaab adag oo lagu rido Marseille kadib rabshadihii Vélodrome
item.description: Kooxda Bulgaria ee Levski Sofia ayaa ka codsatay UEFA ciqaab adag oo ka dhan ah Olympique de Marseille, kadib dagaallo taageerayaal oo ka dhacay ka hor kulankii Europa League; madaxweynaha Bulgaria ayaa sawirrada ku tilmaamay kuwo naxdin leh.

item.title: Warbixin: CIA oo laga yaabo inay biyo ku qarqisay dad ka badan intii ay qiratay
item.description: Dukumiintiyo laga helay baaritaankii xeer-ilaaliye gaar ah John Durham ayaa muujinaya in hay'adda sirdoonka Mareykanka ee CIA ay laga yaabo inay qof kale ku ciqaabtay habka biyo-ku-qarqinta, oo ka baxsan saddexdii maxbuus ee ay hore u qiratay.

item.title: Chicago Bears oo 39-35 kaga adkaatay Detroit Lions ciyaartii Thanksgiving
item.description: Chicago Bears ayaa Khamiistii kaga adkaatay Detroit Lions 39-35 ciyaar NFL ah oo xamaasad leh, kadib markii Caleb Williams uu ilbiriqsiyo ka hor dhammaadka touchdown u gudbiyay Rome Odunze.

item.title: Crystal Palace oo 2-1 ku garaacday Real Sociedad, Thomas Frank oo helay guushiisii ugu horreysay
item.description: Crystal Palace ayaa Khamiistii London kaga soo laabatay 1-0 kuna garaacday Real Sociedad 2-1 kulan Europa League ah, taasoo u ahayd guushii ugu horreysay ee tababaraha cusub Thomas Frank.

item.title: Lyon oo 0-0 la gashay Lilleström, VAR oo buriyay rigoore dhammaadkii kulanka
item.description: Olympique Lyonnais ayaa Khamiistii barbaro 0-0 ah la gashay kooxda Norway ee Lilleström kulan Europa League ah, kadib markii VAR uu buriyay rigoore loo dhigay Loïs Openda dhammaadkii kulanka.

item.title: Juventus oo 4-1 ku garaacday Omonia, Ekhator oo dhaliyay goolkiisii ugu horreeyay
item.description: Juventus ayaa Khamiistii garoonka Allianz Stadium kaga adkaatay Omonia Nicosia 4-1 kulan Europa League ah, kadib markii ay gool ka dambeysay, waxayna u dawakhday kaalinta labaad ee wareegga horyaalka.

item.title: Rennes oo 3-1 looga adkaaday Nijmegen, guuldarradii ugu horreysay ee Europa League
item.description: Stade Rennais ayaa Khamiistii dalka Holland looga adkaaday NEC Nijmegen 3-1, taasoo ahayd guuldarradii ugu horreysay ee ay xilli ciyaareedkan kala kulanto Europa League, taageerayaashuna caro ayay muujiyeen.

item.title: Hoffenheim oo ka soo noqotay 0-1 kuna garaacday Sturm Graz 3-1
item.description: Hoffenheim ayaa Khamiistii Sinsheim ku garaacday Sturm Graz 3-1 Europa League, iyadoo saddex gool ku dhalisay 18-kii daqiiqo ee ugu dambeeyay kadib markay qeybta hore ku hoos jirtay 0-1.

item.title: Aaron Rodgers oo noqday ciyaaryahan xor ah, milkiilaha Steelers oo garab istaagay tababaraha
item.description: Qabsade Aaron Rodgers ayaa noqday ciyaaryahan xor ah kadib markii Pittsburgh Steelers ay sii daysay, halka milkiilaha kooxda Art Rooney II uu si buuxda u taageeray tababaraha Mike McCarthy, una tilmaamay ficilka Rodgers amar-diidmo.

item.title: Argentina oo sharci ku mamnuucday in bangiga dhexe lacag u daabaco dowladda
item.description: Baarlamaanka Argentina ayaa Khamiistii ansixiyay sharci mamnuucaya in bangiga dhexe uu lacag u daabaco si loogu daboolo kharashaadka dowladda, taasoo ah tiir muhiim u ah dagaalka Madaxweyne Javier Milei ee ka dhanka ah sicir-bararka.

item.title: Koobka adduunka ee shatranjiga: Gukesh iyo Sindarov oo mar kale barbaro galay ciyaar adag
item.description: Horyaalka adduunka ee shatranjiga Gukesh Dommaraju iyo tartamaha Uzbekistan Javokhir Sindarov ayaa Khamiistii Geneva ku galay barbarro, iyadoo dhibcaha labadoodu ay weli isku mid yihiin.

item.title: Benfica oo 4-0 looga adkaaday Pilsen, waxayna lumisay hogaanka Europa League
item.description: Benfica oo hogaanka u haysay shaxda Europa League ayaa Khamiistii 4-0 kaga dhacday Viktoria Plzeň magaalada Pilsen ee Czech, khaladaad difaac ah ayaana sababay guuldarrada.

item.title: Somaliland oo go'aansatay inay ciidamo xooggan u dirto Awdal iyo Selel kadib xiisado iyo dilal laga soo sheegay Saylac
item.description: Golaha Amniga Somaliland ayaa Khamiistii Hargeysa ku go'aamiyay in ciidamo dheeraad ah la geeyo gobollada Awdal iyo Selel, halkaas oo colaado beeleed iyo dilal laga soo sheegay muddooyinkii u dambeeyay.

item.title: Besiktas oo 2-1 ku garaacday Hapoel Beer Sheva kulan Batumi ka dhacay oo isku dhac booliis darteed loo hakiyay
item.description: Kulanka Europa League ee Besiktas iyo Hapoel Beer Sheva ayaa ku dhawaad 30 daqiiqo la hakiyay kadib markii booliiska Georgia ay faragelin ku sameeyeen taageerayaasha Besiktas, kulankuna wuxuu ku dhammaaday 2-1.

item.title: Bournemouth oo toban ciyaaryahan ku garaacday Celta Vigo 2-1, gaartayna toban guul oo xiriir ah
item.description: Bournemouth ayaa Khamiistii Balaídos kaga adkaatay Celta Vigo 2-1 kulanka Europa League iyadoo toban ciyaaryahan ku ciyaaraysay muddo ka badan saacad, taasoo u ah guushii tobnaad ee xiriir ah.

item.title: Davis Cup: Spain oo aan Alcaraz lahayn ayaa garaacday Austria, waxayna wajahaysaa Britain semi-finalka
item.description: Kooxda Spain ayaa Khamiistii gaartay semi-finalka Davis Cup kadib markii ay ku guuleysatay labada kulan ee kali-ciyaarka ee Austria, iyadoo Carlos Alcaraz uusan ciyaarin.

item.title: Baaritaanka Congress-ka Mareykanka ee FIFA: shaqaale hore iyo kuwo hadda jira oo loo yeeray wareysiyo
item.description: Xildhibaannada Dimuqraadiga ee guddiga garsoorka ee Aqalka Wakiillada Mareykanka ayaa warqado u diray shaqaale FIFA ah si ay uga qaybgalaan wareysiyo ku saabsan qorshihii FIFA Forward Enterprise iyo xiriirka FIFA iyo maamulka Trump.
